name: Elementys
storyline:
In the world of Elementys, mysterious elemental forces shape the land and the creatures that inhabit it.

Beginning as a Wanderer, players embark on a journey to uncover the secrets behind strange disturbances spreading across the world.

As they explore forgotten ruins, dangerous forests and mysterious islands, they encounter powerful creatures, ancient secrets and growing threats.

By mastering the elements of Fire, Water, Earth and Wind, adventurers must grow stronger, face powerful enemies and discover the truth behind the mysterious energy known as Elementys.
summary:
Elementys Online is a free-to-play 2D pixel-art MMORPG set in an open fantasy world.

Players can explore different regions, choose between four elements (Fire, Water, Earth and Wind), and develop their character through three classes: Warrior, Rogue and Mage.

The game features real-time combat, challenging bosses, dungeons, crafting professions, talent trees, equipment enchanting, guilds, flying mounts and ranked PvP arenas.

Players can team up to defeat powerful world bosses, collect rare equipment and explore a world filled with quests and secrets.
